entries.party: Democracy Shield Hackathon / Brussels event support
entries.value_display: Flight to Brussels, hotel during the hackathon, and food provided during the hackathon period.
entries.what_it_buys: Practical access to be physically present in Brussels for the hackathon. It buys travel, a place to sleep during the event, and food support during the hackathon window.
entries.what_it_does_not_buy: Editorial control over Hedegreen Research, positive coverage, softer conclusions, suppressed criticism, endorsement language, or any obligation to present the event, organizers, partners, or outputs in a flattering way. It does not make the hackathon a validator of the conclusions.
entries.notes: Declared because the Brussels trip is part of the public Hedegreen Research field context. This support concerns presence and capacity, not the conclusion. Related public note: Hedegreen Research Is Going to Brussels.
entries.output_label: Hedegreen Research Is Going to Brussels

entries.value_display: Physical archive access, meeting room (one day), coffee.
entries.what_it_buys: Access to bound original volumes of Mælkeritidende, 1892–1904. No financial payment made or received.
entries.what_it_does_not_buy: Editorial control over any published output. No obligation to publish in Mælkeritidende. No obligation to present findings in any particular way.

entries.party: Anthropic Economic Research / Anthropic Economic Index Survey
entries.value_display: $15.00 USD paid to Dennis Hedegreen personally via Tremendous.
entries.what_it_buys: Compensation for Dennis Hedegreen's personal time spent participating in the Anthropic Economic Index Survey. This was not paid to Hedegreen Research as a project, publication, sponsorship, contract, donation, or commissioned analysis.
entries.what_it_does_not_buy: Editorial control over Hedegreen Research. No obligation to publish about Anthropic. No obligation to present Anthropic, AI systems, or economic AI effects in any particular way. No access to unpublished Hedegreen Research material. No influence over conclusions, wording, corrections, or future analysis.
entries.notes: Disclosed because Dennis Hedegreen is the operator of Hedegreen Research and the survey topic relates to AI, labor, and economic research. Anthropic stated that future participation may be invited again in approximately six months. The redemption link/token is intentionally not published.
